row.evidence: Veracode's SSO docs cover SAML with just-in-time (JIT) provisioning and say "To automate provisioning for large numbers of users, we recommend you use the Admin API"; no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: Quote-only: no public plans or prices (veracode.com/pricing redirects to the platform page; buying is via demo/sales). No SCIM in the docs sitemap, API reference or SSO docs. Users arrive via SAML JIT provisioning (enabled through Veracode Technical Support) or via the Identity REST API (create/read/update/delete users, teams, roles, business units; delete a user's JWT sessions), which admins can script. Okta's OIN app is SAML only; the Entra gallery app is SSO with JIT. Audit log entries are available from the Reporting REST API (AUDIT report type). REST APIs are limited to 500 calls/minute per IP address.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint found in Veracode's docs (sitemap of 870 pages contains no SCIM page); Veracode points to SAML JIT and its own APIs for provisioning.

scopes: Admin API role (API user) or Administrator role (UI user)

endpoints.purpose: Create a UI, SAML or API user
Delete all JWT tokens (sessions) for a user

rate_limits.text: All REST APIs: 500 calls/minute per IP address; HTTP 429 when exceeded.

limitations.text: The legacy Admin XML API is deprecated for organisations on the new SSO/JIT workflow; use the Identity API.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SAML as a supported capability (read from page markup); no provisioning actions are checked.
